utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everybody. Madam Registrar, or Mr. Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case IT-08-91-A, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Could I have the appearances of the parties. Prosecution first.

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Sarah Finnin for the Prosecution, appearing with Aditya Menon and Janet Stewart, our Case Manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Appearances for Mr. Stanisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Slobodan Zecevic appearing for Mr. Stanisic today. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And appearances for Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: MS. CMERIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Mr. President, Tatjana Cmeric appearing today for Mr. Zupljanin. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Before I commence, I would like to know whether all -- whether everyone here can hear and understand the proceedings in a language that they understand, particularly the accused. Mr. Stanisic. THE APPELLANT STANISIC: [Interpretation] Yes, I can hear the interpretation, I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Zupljanin. THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Interpretation] Everything is all right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So this Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Rule 65 bis paragraph (B) requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the filing of a Notice of Appeal, and thereafter within 120 days after the last Status Conference. The reason or the purpose for such a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. In the present case the parties filed Notices of Appeal on 13th May 2013, and the first Status Conference was held on 1st September 2013. The second to eighth Status Conferences were held on 11 December 2013, 9th April, 24 July, and 12 November 2014, and 9th March, 30th June, and 15th October 2015, respectively. Today's Status Conference is the ninth in this case and was scheduled pursuant to an order signed by me and issued on the 11th of January, 2016. The first item on the agenda for today's Status Conference is for me to inquire about the detention conditions and health of the two appellants, Mr. Stanisic and Mr. Zupljanin. So I am going to inquire into the status of your detention conditions and health situations. Mr. Stanisic, I start with you. If you have any concerns in relation to the condition of your detention of your state of health, I would invite to you raise them now; and if you prefer, this discussion with take place in private session. THE APPELLANT STANISIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, no need. As for my health, it's average. The conditions are bearable for the time being, and there are no changes to speak of.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Zupljanin, same question to you. And if you prefer, the discussion can take place in private session. THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I don't think there's any need for private session, although I would prefer to be able to say something nice, but I can't, unfortunately. You have probably been informed that two days ago Mr. Zdravko Tolimir died and we were all hard hit by his death. Regrettably, he is the third person to die in the last six months, and it is very hard on all of us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. But otherwise your state of detention and state of health is okay? You have no complaints? THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Interpretation] Well, "panta rhei," all things in a flux, nothing changes, nothing happens. The time does its work, and as I said last time, we are just getting older, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, you're not the only one who is getting older, Mr. Zupljanin. Thank you so much. I will now deal with the recent procedural history. Before turning to any issues that the two appellants may wish to raise, I will outline the recent procedural developments in this case. Even though this information is known to the parties, one of the purposes of a Status Conference is to inform the people outside the Tribunal of what is happening in a given particular case. In setting out the procedural history, I will focus on decisions an orders issued since the last Status Conference which, as I said before, was held on the 15th of October of last year. I recall that on the 30th October 2015, the Appeals Chamber issued a Scheduling Order setting 16th December 2015 as the date for the appeal hearing in this days. On 4th December 2015, the Appeals Chamber issued an addendum to the Scheduling Order for the appeal hearing, in which it set out the timetable for the hearing and invited the parties to address specific issues in their submissions. The Prosecution filed an urgent motion seeking a revision of the timetable for the appeal hearing on 7th December 2015 which the Appeals Chamber granted in part in its decision of 11th December 2015. The Appeals Chamber heard oral arguments of all parties in a long sitting on the 16th of December, 2015. I take this opportunity to once more thank the parties for their submissions on the day and their full co-operation throughout the hearing. The Appeals Chamber will issue judgement in due course and I can also inform you that for the time being at least we are on track. We have a date in mind and an hopefully we will be able to stick to it. Last item on the agenda, whether Prosecution or Defence would like to raise any issues. I will start with the Prosecution. Would you like to raise --

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: Nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Stanisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We have nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And counsel for Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: MS. CMERIC
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President, nothing to raise at this time. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you very much, Ms. Cmeric. I think that's all. This concludes today's Status Conference. I thank you all for your attendance and co-operation and call these proceedings to a close. Thank you.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
